name: piko-sh
description: Official marketplace for the Piko web framework's Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: piko
plugins.description: Piko language intelligence for .pk and .pkc files - diagnostics, hover, completions, navigation, and project analysis, backed by the piko-lsp language server. Requires the piko-lsp binary on PATH (install the Piko CLI, or download from the GitHub releases).
